caption: A clear stemmed glass filled with water stands on a red tabletop before papers, one split between a dark gray block and white, another with diagonal stripes at the right. At the opening frame a hand is already extended from the right, its fingers resting against the glass wall. It holds this contact through the first part of the clip. The hand then loosens and pulls back, blurring as it moves rightward until it exits the frame. Throughout this motion the glass itself does not shift and the water stays level and undisturbed. The papers behind remain fixed against the tan wall. After the hand leaves, the scene holds on the still glass for the rest of the excerpt.
